purpose: One visual authoring pass over existing evidence; compact action rows end the report

presentation.title: Value water-based strawberry surges +38.2% while chocolate-coated softens -4.6%
presentation.html:
Main observations

All 4 districts · 4 SKUs

Value price · Strawberry · Water-based

+38.2% 14d dev: +44.6%
Fill rate: 88.2%

Store replenishment orders surged systematically across all 20 outlets, outstripping warehouse supply and accumulating 1,859 unfilled units over 14 days. Demand accelerated further into the second week (+56.3% raw deviation), making replenishment restoration an immediate operational priority.

All 4 districts · 10 SKUs

Other chocolate-coated

-4.6% 14d dev: -5.7%
Fill rate: 99.3%

Reorders across chocolate-coated cones and crunch bars drifted steadily below expectation across every district, dropping -8.6% in the latest 7 days. Because delivery fulfillment was unconstrained at 99.3%, this reflects an underlying cooling in store intake rather than distribution bottlenecks.

Network demand is pivoting away from richer chocolate-coated cones toward high-refreshment water-based formats. While warehouse fulfillment comfortably supported chocolate lines, distribution shortages in value water-based bars warrant immediate rebalancing.

Secondary observations

All 4 districts · 3 SKUs

Other value price · Strawberry (Dairy)

+0.2% 14d dev: -0.6%
Fill rate: 100.0%

Dairy-based value strawberry bars tracked baseline expectations almost perfectly, with 6,345 units requested against 6,383.8 expected. This stability confirms the mid-summer demand surge is specific to water-based ice bars rather than a general affinity for strawberry flavouring.

Merchandising & Planning Checks
  • Did regional stores run dedicated end-cap placements or promotional chillers for water-based fruit bars that explain the localized surge beyond normal summer seasonality?
  • Do field merchandisers see chocolate-coated demand stabilizing as school holidays continue, or is softness expected to persist through August?
